thesis: The page is an Omaha winter morning stamped in degrees: every section is struck with its temperature like a road-sign numeral, and frost creeps in from the edges the colder the reading gets.

signature.name: Degree Stamp + Frost Edge
signature.summary: A slab-numeral degree reading (-8°, 34°, 88°, 0°) struck into each section's corner with a ring-degree glyph and a short problem line; the section's border carries an SVG frost crystal edge whose depth is set by --cold (0 to 1). Hero: giant -8° letters mask the snowy blue-hour photo. Story: the stamp counts down 104 to -8 across four scenes while frost grows in. Proof: review cards stamped with the season they came from. Price sheet sorted coldest first. Footer: the 0° brand stamp thaws to amber on hover.

palette.family: Blue Hour Winter + Frost White + Garage-Light Amber

layoutMoves: sections ordered as a year that gets colder: 104°F → 88°F → 34°F → −8°F, stamps in a 2-col left margin on desktop
price sheet as a weather table sorted coldest first, each row a degree stamp + sample range
frost-edged bands on winter blue alternating with frost-white paper; one amber garage-light band for the quote form

motion.intro: Frost clears from the -8° mask letters from the centre out (radial mask, 900 ms) revealing the photo; h1 lines rise 70 ms stagger; skipped on reduced motion.
stories: count: a four-scene pinned story where the stamp counts 104 → 88 → 34 → −8 and --cold drives the frost edge in (stacked cards < 640px)
motion.hover: thaw: frost edge recedes and the stamp warms to amber on hover/focus of cards and buttons
